headline: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from a year ago even as total revenue hit a record, bitcoin is holding near $80,500 into Wednesday's Fed decision, and Ripple's new trust bank comes with a Robinhood deal for its RLUSD stablecoin.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko coin pages around 23:58 UTC Tue 27 Oct (06:58 Wed Bangkok). ETH and SOL 24h changes are left out because the pages showed conflicting figures. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 48, Neutral, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, read around 23:59 UTC 27 Oct.

stories.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue falls 55% even as total revenue hits a record
stories.summary: Robinhood reported its July-September results after Tuesday's close. Total revenue was a record, but crypto trading revenue more than halved from a year earlier, and prediction markets now bring in more than crypto. The stock fell after hours.
points: Total revenue rose 12% from a year earlier to $1.42B, just under the $1.43B analysts expected, per CoinDesk.
Crypto revenue was $120M, down 55%, on crypto trading volume of $50B, down 38%, per CoinDesk. Event contract (prediction market) revenue was $173M, up more than 6x, per the company's release.

Reported earnings were $0.51 a share, down 16% per the company's release and below the $0.55 expected per CoinDesk; on an adjusted basis earnings were $0.60, above the $0.55 estimate, per Investing.com.
Net income fell 14% to $476M; funded customers rose 7% to 28.7M, per the company's release.
Shares were down about 5% after hours per CoinDesk; Investing.com had them down 7.36% at $87.60.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,500 as the Fed decides Wednesday
stories.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $80,000 early Tuesday and recovered. The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday afternoon US time, inflation and growth data follow on Thursday, and a large batch of bitcoin options expires on Friday.
points: Bitcoin recovered from an early low near $79,400 and was around $80,600 in an article published mid-afternoon US time Tuesday, per Bitcoin Magazine.
The Fed's range is 3.75-4.00% after a hike in September, per Newsquawk; CME FedWatch showed 90.6% odds of a hold, per Bloomingbit.
September PCE inflation and the first estimate of Q3 GDP are both due Thursday at 8:30am ET, per crypto.news.
Friday's Deribit bitcoin options expiry is estimated at about $11B to $12B, with 'max pain' estimates of $76,000 to $79,000, per FinanceFeeds. Max pain is not a price target.

stories.title: Ripple's new US trust bank comes with a Robinhood deal for RLUSD
stories.summary: The OCC, the US regulator for national banks, gave Ripple final approval to launch a national trust bank that will manage the reserves behind its RLUSD stablecoin. On Tuesday Robinhood and Ripple announced a partnership that includes bringing RLUSD to the Robinhood app later this year.
points: Ripple disclosed final OCC approval on 26 Oct, per Bitcoin.com; the trust bank is authorized to manage the segregated reserves backing RLUSD, per The Block.
Robinhood will bring RLUSD to its app later in 2026; it is already live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, per Bitcoin.com.
Robinhood is set to use RLUSD on the XRP Ledger through Bitstamp's institutional business and will adopt Ripple Treasury software, per Bitcoin.com.

sources.label: The Block: Ripple gains final OCC approval

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs take in $110M, ether ETFs lose $89M
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in about $110M on Monday 26 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT, while spot ether ETFs saw $88.58M of outflows, per Crypto Briefing.

briefs.title: Galaxy swings to a $323M profit
briefs.summary: Galaxy reported Q3 net income of $323M, against an $85M loss in Q2, and approved a new $200M share buyback, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy paused bitcoin buying last week
briefs.summary: Strategy made no bitcoin purchases or sales in the week ending 25 Oct and holds 848,517 BTC; it spent about $204.9M buying back its STRC preferred stock instead, per Analytics Insight.

briefs.title: Suspected exploit at Predict Fun
briefs.summary: On-chain trackers flagged suspected unauthorized outflows of more than $300K from Predict Fun, a prediction market on BNB Chain; the team had not confirmed the cause or total, per The Crypto Times.

briefs.title: Keystone wallet customer data leaked
briefs.summary: Keystone said customer names, contact details and shipping addresses were exposed, while recovery phrases and private keys remain secure. It warned buyers about fake replacement devices and refund offers, per Bitcoin.com.

calendar.event: Reserve Bank of New Zealand rate decision
calendar.note: Rate 2.75%. Newsquawk's RBNZ preview puts a hike to 3.00% at about 93% priced; its week-ahead note says 75-80%, with Westpac expecting a hold. Not yet announced when this edition was written.
Rate 2.25%; markets about 80% priced for a hike to 2.50% (Newsquawk). Strategy's common shareholders vote on daily dividends for its preferred shares at 10:00am ET (21:00 Bangkok), per its proxy.
Range 3.75-4.00%; a hold is expected (CME FedWatch 90.6%, per Bloomingbit). Chair Warsh's press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok). No new projections until December (Newsquawk).

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (first estimate) and September PCE inflation
calendar.note: GDP forecasts differ: about 3.0% (Newsquawk) vs 1.7% (AP survey); prior 2.2%. PCE 3.6% a year expected, prior 3.4%; core 3.1%, prior 3.0% (Newsquawk). ECB decision 9:15am ET (20:15 Bangkok), hold expected.
Both report after the US close. Coinbase consensus EPS -$0.23, revenue $1.21B (MarketBeat). Token unlocks the same day: FF ~$19.5M and CARDS ~$19.1M, per the unlock data on this page.
At 08:00 UTC. Estimates range from about $11B to $12.2B, with max pain between $76,000 and $79,000 (FinanceFeeds, CryptoTicker). Max pain is not a price target.
Rate 1.25%, hold expected (Newsquawk); no fixed announcement time.

calendar.event: US Employment Cost Index (Q3) and Chicago PMI
calendar.note: ECI prior 0.9% (BLS). Chicago PMI at 9:45am ET (20:45 Bangkok), prior 58.8.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: KMNO, W, TIA, EIGEN, SUI, M, ENA, BTW, KITE
calendar.note: KMNO ~$9.9M and W ~$0.6M (30th), TIA ~$3.0M (31st), EIGEN ~$7.1M, MemeCore (M) ~$53.3M and SUI (size unconfirmed; trackers differ on 1 or 3 Nov) on 1 Nov, ENA ~$8.5M and BTW ~$169.7M (2 Nov), KITE ~$89.1M (3 Nov), per the unlock data on this page. US clocks fall back on Sun 1 Nov.

calendar.event: US midterm elections; JOLTS job openings (10:00am ET, 22:00 Bangkok)
calendar.note: JOLTS prior 7.1M. Polls close 6:00pm ET Tue to 1:00am ET Wed (06:00-13:00 Wed Bangkok). Reserve Bank of Australia also decides Tue 3 Nov (rate 4.60%, roughly even odds of a hike). Block reports after the US close.
The next Fed decision after this week is Wed 9 Dec, 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu 10 Dec Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve.
